model.machinery: D0 v2 (spec 72125c3b): p515_s56_tn_realized_resolve_v2.build_arm_v2 = v1 build_arm (production NetworkData.build_model of the TN of a deep-copied derived instance; candidate x0 applied as production; terminal published available capacity; _prepare_transmission_objectives_for_admm; interface settlement weight 0; ADN setup as create_transmission_network_model; no ADMM terms, no pin, no row 18) + isolate_shared_ess (inert at x0: no storage)
model.per_scenario_note: with fixed exchanges and no storage the 9 scenarios of a block share no free variable, so one multi-scenario solve per block equals the 9 per-scenario solves (D0 practice)

objective_convention: EUR of total discounted cost (block weight w_b = production _get_admm_block_weight = years x days / 1.02^(y - 2025)). w_b C_central: step 3 gross (model.objective with settlement weight 0, no row 18, no pin, no salvage). Q_pin: pinned AA-off arm at terminal cycle K, contracted settlement excluded (= w_b [TSO base + sum_DN (DSO base + DSO covariance settlement)]). C_TN-resolve = w_b [C_TN,B + sum_DN DSO base]: C_TN,B = TN-only model.objective (settlement weight 0, no pin, no row 18, no ADMM terms; generation + flexibility + load curtailment + slack terms + zero-weighted penalties) at the realized per-scenario DN exchanges; DSO base = the pinned arm DN operating cost sum_s omega_s obj_s (no settlement, no pin). T1 = C_TN-resolve - Q_pin; T2 = w_b C_central - C_TN-resolve; D_b = w_b C_central - Q_pin = T1 + T2.

B1.numeric_addition: T1 >= D_b - tau_b (implied by B2 given D_b > 0; recorded so B1 and B2 are read together, not as independent confirmations)
B1.statement: pinned-accounting term T1 = C_TN-resolve - Q_pin > 0 on both calibration blocks (2025|Winter, 2035|Summer)

B2.statement: DN re-optimization gain T2 = w_b C_central - C_TN-resolve <= tau_b on both calibration blocks
B2.tolerance_rule: tau_b = w_b x 2 EUR/day (A: 910.00 EUR; B 2035|Summer: 746.52 EUR): the solve tolerance, 57x the step 3 merged-vs-single stopping offset (0.035 EUR/day) and 1.1e-5 (A) / 1.3e-5 (B) relative to C_central; local-optimality caveat: C_central is a local IPOPT optimum and the composite (TN re-solve + pinned DN schedules) is feasible for the merged model only where the TN interface voltage equals the DN root voltage (mismatch reported beside)

B3.operational: a = T1 + T2 = (C_TN-resolve - Q_pin) + (w_b C_central - C_TN-resolve); b = D_b = w_b C_central - Q_pin; summands |C_TN-resolve|, |Q_pin|, |w_b C_central|, |C_TN-resolve| (a) and |w_b C_central|, |Q_pin| (b); u = 2^-53
B3.statement: T1 + T2 == D_b to the adopted M1 tolerance: |a - b| <= 64 u sum|summands| over both sides, floor 1e-6 EUR

CTRL.statement: not deciding: w_b (C_TN,A - TSO base) <= tau_b (the TN re-optimized at the pinned scenario-common exchange without ADMM terms is no costlier than the ADMM TSO terminal point; D0 v2 precedent: -0.05 to -9.2 EUR/day on 20 blocks)

P_solves.statement: 6/6 solves strict "Optimal Solution Found." (termination optimal, production success test true); a block whose Arm B fails is indeterminate for B1-B3

predictions.reading_rule: B1 and B2 are read per calibration block; each term is also stated against its resolution (T1: the last-10-cycle max |step| of Q_pin, and step 4 bar S_b; T2: the last-10-cycle max |step| of w_b sum_DN DSO base); a term smaller than its resolution is indeterminate in sign. The result is reported as the causal split; the earlier accounting split (wC - Q_pin in full + covariance) is an identity with no sign content and is not called a decomposition.

solver.success_test: production helper_functions.solver_result_succeeded(result); nothing extracted from a rejected solve; every status asserted as a check (a failed solve fails the run record, it is never read as loaded); strict = IPOPT exit "Optimal Solution Found."
